verdict.rationale: Spline documents its own public Code API, which lets developer code trigger actions and modify object properties in exported scenes. That gives programmatic control of the runtime scene, but not of the editor, files or account. The OpenAPI probe found nothing at any candidate path, and editor-driving via the MCP server belongs to a separate story, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API for driving the editor and files, API reference or OpenAPI spec, auth and rate-limit docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: It enables you to trigger actions, modify object properties, and create dynamic, responsive 3D environments directly from your existing code and user interface.
The Code API allows you to seamlessly integrate interactive 3D experiences into your projects, offering greater control and customization.
